text_en: Once more Jesus spoke to them in parables, saying:
text_cn: 耶稣又开口用比喻对他们说：

text_en: “The kingdom of heaven may be compared to a king who gave a wedding banquet for his son.
text_cn: “天国好比一个国王，为自己的儿子办婚宴。

text_en: He sent his slaves to call those who had been invited to the wedding banquet, but they would not come.
text_cn: 他打发仆人去召被请的人来赴婚宴，他们却不愿意来。

text_en: Again he sent other slaves, saying, ‘Tell those who have been invited: Look, I have prepared my dinner, my oxen and my fat calves have been slaughtered, and everything is ready; come to the wedding banquet. ’
text_cn: 又派其他的仆人去，说：你们对被请的人说：看，我已经预备好了我的盛宴，我的公牛和肥畜都宰杀了，一切都齐备了，你们来赴婚宴吧！

text_en: But they made light of it and went away, one to his farm, another to his business,
text_cn: 他们却不理：有的往自己的田里去了，有的作自己的生意去了；

text_en: while the rest seized his slaves, mistreated them, and killed them.
text_cn: 其余的竟拿住他的仆人，凌辱后杀死了。

text_en: The king was enraged. He sent his troops, destroyed those murderers, and burned their city.
text_cn: 国王于是动了怒，派自己的军队消灭了那些杀人的凶手，焚毁了他们的城市。

text_en: Then he said to his slaves, ‘The wedding is ready, but those invited were not worthy.
text_cn: 然后对仆人说：婚宴已经齐备了，但是被请的人都不配。

text_en: Go therefore into the main streets, and invite everyone you find to the wedding banquet. ’
text_cn: 如今你们到各路口去，凡是你们所遇到的，都请来赴婚宴。

text_en: Those slaves went out into the streets and gathered all whom they found, both good and bad; so the wedding hall was filled with guests.
text_cn: 那些仆人就出去到大路上，凡遇到的，无论坏人好人，都召集了来，婚宴上就满了坐席的人。

text_en: “But when the king came in to see the guests, he noticed a man there who was not wearing a wedding robe,
text_cn: 国王进来巡视坐席的客人，看见在那里有一个没有穿婚宴礼服的人，

text_en: and he said to him, ‘Friend, how did you get in here without a wedding robe? ’ And he was speechless.
text_cn: 便对他说：朋友，你怎么到这里来，不穿婚宴礼服？那人默然无语。

text_en: Then the king said to the attendants, ‘Bind him hand and foot, and throw him into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth. ’
text_cn: 国王遂对仆役说：你们捆起他的脚和手来，把他丢在外面的黑暗中：在那里要有哀号和切齿。

text_en: For many are called, but few are chosen. ”
text_cn: 因为被召的人多，被选的人少。”

text_en: Then the Pharisees went and plotted to entrap him in what he said.
text_cn: 那时，法利塞人去商讨怎样在言谈上叫耶稣入圈套。

text_en: So they sent their disciples to him, along with the Herodians, saying, “Teacher, we know that you are sincere, and teach the way of God in accordance with truth, and show deference to no one; for you do not regard people with partiality.
text_cn: 他们遂派自己的门徒和黑落德党人到他跟前说：“师傅，我们知道你是真诚的，按真理教授天主的道路，不顾忌任何人，因为你不看人的情面。

text_en: Tell us, then, what you think. Is it lawful to pay taxes to the emperor, or not? ”
text_cn: 如今请你告诉我们：你以为如何？给凯撒纳税，可以不可以？”

text_en: But Jesus, aware of their malice, said, “Why are you putting me to the test, you hypocrites?
text_cn: 耶稣看破他们的恶意，就说：“假善人，你们为什么要试探我？

text_en: Show me the coin used for the tax. ” And they brought him a denarius.
text_cn: 拿一个税币给我看看！”他们便递给他一块“德纳”。

text_en: Then he said to them, “Whose head is this, and whose title? ”
text_cn: 耶稣对他们说：“这肖像和名号是谁的？”

text_en: They answered, “The emperor’s. ” Then he said to them, “Give therefore to the emperor the things that are the emperor’s, and to God the things that are God’s. ”
text_cn: 他们对他说：“凯撒的。”耶稣对他们说：“那么，凯撒的，就应归还凯撒；天主的，就应归还天主。”

text_en: When they heard this, they were amazed; and they left him and went away.
text_cn: 他们听了大为惊异，遂离开他走了。

text_en: The same day some Sadducees came to him, saying there is no resurrection; and they asked him a question, saying,
text_cn: 在那一天，否认复活的撒杜塞人，来到他跟前，问他说：

text_en: “Teacher, Moses said, ‘If a man dies childless, his brother shall marry the widow, and raise up children for his brother. ’
text_cn: “师傅，梅瑟说：谁若死了没有儿子，他的弟弟就应娶他的女人为妻，给他哥哥立嗣。

text_en: Now there were seven brothers among us; the first married, and died childless, leaving the widow to his brother.
text_cn: 在我们中曾有兄弟七人：第一个娶了妻没有子嗣就死了，遗下了妻子给他的弟弟；

text_en: The second did the same, so also the third, down to the seventh.
text_cn: 连第二个与第三个，直到第七个都是这样。

text_en: Last of all, the woman herself died.
text_cn: 最后，那妇人也死了。

text_en: In the resurrection, then, whose wife of the seven will she be? For all of them had married her. ”
text_cn: 那么，在复活的时候，她是七人中那一个的妻子？因为都曾娶过她。”

text_en: Jesus answered them, “You are wrong, because you know neither the scriptures nor the power of God.
text_cn: 耶稣回答他们说：“你们错了，不明了经书，也不明了天主的能力，

text_en: For in the resurrection they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.
text_cn: 因为复活的时候，也不娶也不嫁，好像在天上的天使一样。

text_en: And as for the resurrection of the dead, have you not read what was said to you by God,
text_cn: 关于死人复活，你们不曾念过天主对你们所说

text_en: ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’? He is God not of the dead, but of the living. ”
text_cn: ‘我是亚巴郎的天主，依撒格的天主及雅各伯的天主’的话吗？他不是死人的，而是活人的天主。”

text_en: And when the crowd heard it, they were astounded at his teaching.
text_cn: 民众听了，就都惊讶他的道理。

text_en: When the Pharisees heard that he had silenced the Sadducees, they gathered together,
text_cn: 法利塞人听说耶稣使撒杜塞人闭口无言，就聚集在一起；

text_en: and one of them, a lawyer, asked him a question to test him.
text_cn: 他们中有一个法学士试探他，发问说：

text_en: “Teacher, which commandment in the law is the greatest? ”
text_cn: “师傅，法律中那条诫命是最大的？”

text_en: He said to him, “‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind. ’
text_cn: 耶稣对他说：“‘你应全心，全灵，全意，爱上主你的天主。’

text_en: This is the greatest and first commandment.
text_cn: 这是最大也是第一条诫命。

text_en: And a second is like it: ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself. ’
text_cn: 第二条与此相似：你应当爱近人，如你自己。

text_en: On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets. ”
text_cn: 全部法律和先知，都系于这两条诫命。”

text_en: Now while the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them this question:
text_cn: 法利塞人聚集在一起时，耶稣问他们说：

text_en: “What do you think of the Messiah? Whose son is he? ” They said to him, “The son of David. ”
text_cn: “关于默西亚，你们以为如何？他是谁的儿子？”他们回答说：“达味的。”

text_en: He said to them, “How is it then that David by the Spirit calls him Lord, saying,
text_cn: 耶稣对他们说：“怎么达味因圣神的感动，称他为主说：

text_en: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I put your enemies under your feet”’?
text_cn: ‘上主对我主说：你坐在我右边，等我把你的仇敌放在你的脚下？’

text_en: If David thus calls him Lord, how can he be his son? ”
text_cn: 那么，如果达味称他为主，他怎会是达味的儿子？”

text_en: No one was able to give him an answer, nor from that day did anyone dare to ask him any more questions.
text_cn: 没有人能回答他一句话。从那天以后，没有谁再敢问他。
